points.K22: 小量泄漏：吸附、密封、标识
points.K23: 大量泄漏：提醒他人、撤离、求援

points.K27: 吸入：转移到新鲜空气处

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上一个带盖的标本瓶，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a closed specimen jar on it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲甲醛的危害和安全使用。
overlay: 甲醛的危害与安全使用

shots.scene: 眼睛、肺、手套、通风橱四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an eye, a pair of lungs, a glove, and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 认危害、会防护、懂应急。

shots.scene: 阿杰打开一个大标本瓶，皱着眉往后躲
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens a large specimen jar at an open bench and leans back, frowning and squinting.
shots.narration: 阿杰在敞开的台面上打开标本瓶。

shots.scene: 阿杰揉眼睛、捂鼻子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rubs his eyes and covers his nose with the back of his hand.
shots.narration: 眼睛发酸，鼻子发呛。

shots.scene: 小研快步过来，指向通风橱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, walks over and points to a fume hood.
shots.narration: 小研提醒：这是甲醛，要进通风橱。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 甲醛很常用，危害却不简单。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在试剂架前，架上一排空白标签的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a reagent shelf lined with bottles that have blank labels.
shots.narration: 实验室里很多化学品都有潜在危害。

shots.scene: 一瓶空白标签的溶液旁，出现健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of clear solution with a blank label next to a health hazard pictogram and a toxic pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 甲醛很常见，危害却格外特殊。

shots.scene: 一本封面空白的规章册旁有星条旗图标和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank rulebook next to a small American flag icon and a shield icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 美国职业安全卫生署专门为它立了标准。

shots.scene: 手、眼睛、鼻腔三个图标，周围有红色刺激波纹
shots.prompt_en: Three icons of a hand, an eye and a nose, each surrounded by small red irritation marks. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤、眼睛、黏膜，一接触就受刺激。

shots.scene: 手背皮肤发红的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the back of a hand with a red patch and a small burn mark. No people.
shots.narration: 轻则发红刺痛，重则灼伤。

shots.scene: 放大镜对着一个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a simple person pictogram showing red marks on the eyes and hands. No people.
shots.narration: 这些症状都很好识别。

shots.scene: 人形图标咳嗽，周围飘着淡淡的蒸气
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram coughing, surrounded by faint wavy vapor lines. No people.
shots.narration: 吸入甲醛气体，会咳嗽、恶心。

shots.scene: 胃和喉咙图标亮起红色
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a throat and a stomach glowing red. No people.
shots.narration: 还可能剧烈呕吐、腹泻、嗓子发炎。

shots.scene: 浓重蒸气云旁的红色骷髅警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A thick vapor cloud next to a red warning triangle with a skull pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度极高时，可致抽搐、昏迷甚至死亡。

shots.section_title: 长期接触：致癌与慢性损伤
shots.scene: 时钟图标旁，人形图标逐渐变灰
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon beside a person pictogram that slowly turns grey. No people.
shots.narration: 长期接触的伤害，往往不会马上显现。
overlay: 长期接触：致癌与慢性损伤

shots.section_title: 长期接触：致癌与慢性损伤
shots.scene: 健康危害象形图旁的细胞图标
shots.prompt_en: A health hazard pictogram next to a cell icon with a damaged strand. No people.
shots.narration: 甲醛是致癌物，过量接触增加患癌风险。

shots.section_title: 长期接触：致癌与慢性损伤
shots.scene: 肺部图标上出现灰色斑块
shots.prompt_en: A pair of lungs icon with grey patches spreading on it. No people.
shots.narration: 反复接触，还会造成永久性呼吸道损伤。

shots.scene: 小研摸着喉咙，在办公室对老周说话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student touches her throat and talks to the older man, her supervisor, in the lab office.
shots.narration: 怀疑自己接触过量、出现症状，

shots.scene: 老周点点头，拿起桌上的电话
shots.prompt_en: The older man nods and picks up a telephone at his desk.
shots.narration: 立即报告主管。

shots.scene: 红十字图标旁一个绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A red cross icon with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 大多数情况，经过治疗都能好转。

shots.scene: 小研衣领上别着一个圆形采样器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a small round passive air sampler clipped to her collar near her face.
shots.narration: 常用或大量使用甲醛，要监测接触量。

shots.scene: 采样器图标，呼吸带区域用虚线圈出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a person outline with a dotted circle around the nose and mouth area and a small sampler icon inside. No people.
shots.narration: 采的是你呼吸带里的空气。

shots.scene: 波动曲线和一条平均线，下面一个时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A line chart with a wavy curve and a straight average line, a clock icon marked eight hours below it. No people.
shots.narration: 结果和允许接触限值比，按8小时平均。

shots.scene: 平均线升到红色限值线之上，出现黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The straight average line rises above a red limit line, and a yellow warning triangle appears. No people.
shots.narration: 限值是百万分之零点七五。

shots.scene: 王老师在通风柜旁勾选空白的整改单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks items on a blank corrective action form beside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 达到或超过，必须特别防护到降下来。

shots.scene: 曲线上一个尖峰，平均线却很平
shots.prompt_en: A line chart where the average line stays flat while one sharp spike shoots up. No people.
shots.narration: 只看平均，可能掩盖短时高峰。

shots.scene: 尖峰被红圈圈住，旁边一个秒表图标
shots.prompt_en: The sharp spike is circled in red, with a small stopwatch icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 15分钟短时限值，不超过百万分之二。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一张写满数字图标的空白卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank card covered with simple number icons and smiles.
shots.narration: 数字看着多，都是为保护你。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手向老周提问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand and asks the older man, his supervisor, a question.
shots.narration: 有疑问，就问主管。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给一群学生讲课，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 接触达百万分之零点一的，每年培训。

shots.scene: 实验室平面图上几个位置亮起警示点
shots.prompt_en: A simple floor plan of a lab with three spots glowing as small warning dots. No people.
shots.narration: 先弄清：哪里在用甲醛。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白的培训记录上签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank training record at a desk.
shots.narration: 知道怎样限制有害接触。

shots.scene: 小研举起一个贴着空白标签的瓶子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a bottle with a blank label and a health hazard pictogram.
shots.narration: 容器标签，是最直接的信息来源。

shots.scene: 空白标签图标的第一行亮起，旁边一只化学品瓶
shots.prompt_en: A blank label icon where the top row lights up beside a chemical bottle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 含甲醛超过0.1%，就要标明含甲醛。

shots.scene: 一块材料散出淡淡的蒸气线，挂着空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A piece of material releasing faint vapor lines, with a blank label attached. No people.
shots.narration: 能释放百万分之零点一的材料也要标。

shots.scene: 空白标签图标的箭头指向单位办公室和安全数据单
shots.prompt_en: A blank label icon with arrows pointing to an office building icon and a blank safety data sheet binder. No people.
shots.narration: 并写明信息可向单位和SDS获取。

shots.scene: 一张空白标签，带健康危害、感叹号和骷髅象形图
shots.prompt_en: A blank label with a health hazard pictogram, an exclamation mark pictogram and a skull pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 含量更高、释放更多的，还要写明危害。

shots.scene: 健康危害象形图被放大
shots.prompt_en: The health hazard pictogram on the label is enlarged in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 特别要写明：可能致癌。

shots.scene: 小瓶的空白标签太小，箭头指向SDS
shots.prompt_en: A small vial with a tiny blank label, an arrow leading to a blank safety data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 标签写不下，就会指引你看SDS。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰一起翻看空白SDS文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student read a blank safety data sheet binder together.
shots.narration: SDS还告诉你怎样避免过量接触。

shots.section_title: 稀释要小心，稀溶液也有害
shots.scene: 容量瓶和量筒图标旁一个黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A volumetric flask and a graduated cylinder icon next to a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 过去自行稀释高浓度甲醛，要格外小心。
overlay: 稀释要小心，稀溶液也有害

shots.section_title: 稀释要小心，稀溶液也有害
shots.scene: 一排预装好的带盖标本瓶
shots.prompt_en: A row of prefilled specimen containers with screw caps and blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 现在多用预先稀释好的分装容器。

shots.section_title: 稀释要小心，稀溶液也有害
shots.scene: 一瓶稀溶液，空白标签上仍有健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of dilute solution with a blank label that still carries a health hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 可稀溶液，照样有危害。

shots.section_title: 稀释要小心，稀溶液也有害
shots.scene: 一个刻度条上0.1%处亮起警示
shots.prompt_en: A concentration scale where a very low mark lights up with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危害警示，从0.1%就开始要求。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一副防化手套
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a pair of chemical resistant gloves.
shots.narration: 个人防护，是隔离接触最基本的方法。

shots.scene: 三种手套图标，其中一种带绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: Three different glove icons in a row, one marked with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 防护手套，往往针对特定物质设计。

shots.scene: 小研对照墙上的空白选型表挑选手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares gloves with a blank glove selection chart on the wall.
shots.narration: 1%以上的溶液，手套要渗不透。

shots.scene: 小研戴上间接通风的防溅护目镜，调好松紧带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on indirect vent splash goggles and adjusts the strap.
shots.narration: 超过1%，戴能全护眼睛的防溅护目镜。

shots.scene: 只戴面屏不戴护目镜的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a face shield worn without goggles crossed out with a red X, next to an icon of goggles plus face shield with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 面屏能护脸，但不能代替护目镜。

shots.scene: 小研护目镜外再加面屏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears goggles and then lowers a face shield over them.
shots.narration: 需要面屏时，护目镜照样要戴。

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：培训、适配、选对滤盒
shots.scene: 老李拿着半面罩呼吸器和滤盒
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a half-face respirator and a pair of filter cartridges.
shots.narration: 有甲醛气体时，可能要戴呼吸器。
overlay: 呼吸器：培训、适配、选对滤盒

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：培训、适配、选对滤盒
shots.scene: 老李帮阿杰戴上半面罩并检查贴合
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer helps the young male student put on a half-face respirator and check the seal.
shots.narration: 新领呼吸器，要培训和适合性检验。

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：培训、适配、选对滤盒
shots.scene: 日历上每年圈出一天，旁边呼吸器图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with one day each year circled, beside a respirator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 此后至少每年一次。

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：培训、适配、选对滤盒
shots.scene: 两个滤盒图标，中间一个更换箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two cartridge icons with a circular replacement arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 按工作区甲醛水平，配发合适滤盒。

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：培训、适配、选对滤盒
shots.scene: 老周指着空白的呼吸防护计划文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The older man, a supervisor, points at a blank respiratory protection program binder.
shots.narration: 向主管了解单位的呼吸防护计划。

shots.scene: 小研穿上实验服扣好扣子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a lab coat and buttons it up.
shots.narration: 还要穿防护服挡住飞溅。

shots.scene: 水滴从防水面料上滚落
shots.prompt_en: Water droplets bead up and roll off a piece of waterproof fabric. No people.
shots.narration: 防护服要能防水，才能真正挡住。

shots.scene: 阿杰脱下沾污的实验服放进带盖收集箱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes off a stained lab coat and puts it into a closed collection bin with a blank warning label.
shots.narration: 防护服沾污，立即放到指定地点。

shots.scene: 阿杰换上一件干净实验服
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a clean lab coat.
shots.narration: 换上干净的，再回去工作。

shots.scene: 小研翻开空白SDS的操作储存页
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank safety data sheet binder to a page with handling and storage icons.
shots.narration: SDS是关键，操作储存按它来。

shots.scene: 老周指着墙上空白的操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at a blank standard operating procedure poster on the lab wall.
shots.narration: 本实验室的规程，也要严格执行。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风橱旁，气流箭头流入橱内
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fume hood with airflow arrows flowing into it.
shots.narration: 保持通风，是最重要的做法之一。

shots.scene: 小研在通风橱内打开标本瓶，视窗拉低
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a specimen jar inside a fume hood with the sash pulled low.
shots.narration: 开瓶、取材都在通风橱里做。

shots.scene: 蒸气被吸走，远离人形图标的口鼻
shots.prompt_en: Vapor lines are pulled away into an exhaust duct, away from a person pictogram's face. No people.
shots.narration: 把甲醛挡在呼吸带之外。

shots.scene: 下排风取材台和通风橱两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a downdraft grossing station and a fume hood side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 各种通风设备，用法不尽相同。

shots.scene: 阿杰看空白使用说明卡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank instruction card posted beside the fume hood.
shots.narration: 先弄懂它怎么用，再遵守使用规则。

shots.scene: 老周拿着空白应急预案
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds up a blank emergency plan binder in the lab.
shots.narration: 再小心，也要准备好应对意外。

shots.scene: 溢漏处理箱、洗眼器、紧急淋浴三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a spill kit box, an eyewash station and a safety shower. No people.
shots.narration: 熟悉预案，知道应急物资在哪。

shots.section_title: 小量泄漏：吸附、密封、标识
shots.scene: 地上一小摊透明液体，旁边黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A small puddle of clear liquid on the lab floor with a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 小量泄漏，用蛭石或吸附枕吸收。
overlay: 小量泄漏：吸附、密封、标识

shots.section_title: 小量泄漏：吸附、密封、标识
shots.scene: 小研用吸附枕盖住小摊液体
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student covers a small spill with absorbent pillows and granules.
shots.narration: 把液体吸干净。

shots.section_title: 小量泄漏：吸附、密封、标识
shots.scene: 吸附物装入带盖容器，贴上空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Used absorbent pads go into a sealed container with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 废物装进密封容器，贴好标签。

shots.section_title: 大量泄漏：提醒他人、撤离、求援
shots.scene: 地上大片液体和碎瓶的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a large spill with broken glass across the floor and a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 大量泄漏，不要自己处理。
overlay: 大量泄漏：提醒他人、撤离、求援

shots.section_title: 大量泄漏：提醒他人、撤离、求援
shots.scene: 小研挥手提醒阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student waves to warn the young male student across the lab.
shots.narration: 立即提醒周围的人。

shots.section_title: 大量泄漏：提醒他人、撤离、求援
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰快步走出实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student walk quickly out of the lab.
shots.narration: 立即撤离实验室。

shots.section_title: 大量泄漏：提醒他人、撤离、求援
shots.scene: 小研在实验室外走廊打电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call in the corridor outside the lab.
shots.narration: 然后呼叫援助。

shots.section_title: 皮肤接触：脱衣、冲洗、就医
shots.scene: 欣欣站在水槽和紧急淋浴之间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a lab sink and a safety shower.
shots.narration: 接触到甲醛，动作一定要快。
overlay: 皮肤接触：脱衣、冲洗、就医

shots.section_title: 皮肤接触：脱衣、冲洗、就医
shots.scene: 阿杰脱下沾污的外衣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student quickly takes off a contaminated lab coat.
shots.narration: 先脱掉沾污的衣物。

shots.section_title: 皮肤接触：脱衣、冲洗、就医
shots.scene: 阿杰在水槽用肥皂和流水冲洗前臂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his forearm under running water with soap at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 肥皂加大量清水，冲洗15到20分钟。

shots.section_title: 皮肤接触：脱衣、冲洗、就医
shots.scene: 紧急淋浴标志和紧急淋浴
shots.prompt_en: A safety shower sign above a safety shower with water pouring down. No people.
shots.narration: 沾染面积大，立刻用紧急淋浴。

shots.section_title: 皮肤接触：脱衣、冲洗、就医
shots.scene: 紧急淋浴旁的遮挡帘和叠好的干净毛巾衣物
shots.prompt_en: A privacy screen and a folded clean towel and clothes beside the safety shower. No people.
shots.narration: 脱去全部衣物，冲淋至少15分钟。

shots.section_title: 皮肤接触：脱衣、冲洗、就医
shots.scene: 红十字和医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A red cross icon with a hospital building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 任何接触之后，都要就医。

shots.scene: 阿杰捂着眼睛，小研扶他走向洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student covers his eyes as the female graduate student guides him to an eyewash station.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛，马上到洗眼器。

shots.scene: 阿杰用手指撑开眼睑冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends over the eyewash station and holds his eyelids open with his fingers in the water flow.
shots.narration: 撑开眼睑，冲洗至少15分钟。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志旁的红十字
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign next to a red cross icon. No people.
shots.narration: 冲完尽快就医。

shots.scene: 一杯饮用水递向嘴部图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a glass of drinking water being offered toward a mouth icon. No people.
shots.narration: 万一误食，立即给饮用水。

shots.scene: 老周把外套披在坐着的阿杰身上
shots.prompt_en: The older man drapes a jacket over the young male student who is sitting on a chair.
shots.narration: 让人保暖，保持平静。

shots.scene: 医院图标和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A hospital building icon with a red cross icon. No people.
shots.narration: 然后就医。

shots.section_title: 吸入：转移到新鲜空气处
shots.scene: 小研扶着阿杰走到窗边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps the young male student walk out of the lab to an open window in the corridor.
shots.narration: 吸入蒸气，先离开污染区。
overlay: 吸入：转移到新鲜空气处

shots.section_title: 吸入：转移到新鲜空气处
shots.scene: 窗外清新空气的图标
shots.prompt_en: An open window icon with fresh air arrows flowing in. No people.
shots.narration: 到空气新鲜的地方。

shots.section_title: 吸入：转移到新鲜空气处
shots.scene: 小研打电话，阿杰裹着外套坐着
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call while the young male student sits wrapped in a jacket.
shots.narration: 呼叫救护车，保暖安抚，等待救援。

shots.scene: 门上挂起警示标志，门外有禁止进入标志
shots.prompt_en: A closed lab door with a warning sign and a no entry sign. No people.
shots.narration: 施救时，先保护好自己。

shots.scene: 冲进蒸气云的人形图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person rushing into a thick vapor cloud, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不冲进高浓度区域。

shots.scene: 戴呼吸防护的救援人员图标走向浓雾
shots.prompt_en: Pictograms of rescuers wearing full respirators walking toward a vapor cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 交给配有呼吸防护的救援人员。

shots.scene: 阿杰在办公室和老周谈话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student talks with the older man, his supervisor, in the lab office.
shots.narration: 接触后身体受了影响，

shots.scene: 两个岗位图标，箭头指向接触少的一个
shots.prompt_en: Two workstation icons, an arrow moving a person pictogram to the one with fewer vapor lines. No people.
shots.narration: 要暂时调到接触少的岗位。

shots.scene: 日历图标后接问号和对勾图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon followed by a question mark icon and a check mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 过段时间，单位再决定回原岗与否。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起四个手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up four fingers with a cheerful look.
shots.narration: 甲醛有害，但能安全使用。

shots.scene: 眼睛、标签、手套、急救箱四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an eye, a blank label, a glove, and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 知危害、识材料、会防护、备应急。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮着眼睛、肺和健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an eye, lungs and a health hazard pictogram.
shots.narration: 甲醛刺激、有毒，还可能致癌。

shots.scene: 空白标签和空白安全数据单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank label and a blank safety data sheet binder. No people.
shots.narration: 看清标签，读懂SDS，守住限值。

shots.scene: 手套、防溅护目镜和通风橱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of gloves, splash goggles and a fume hood with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 穿戴到位，在通风橱里操作。

shots.scene: 吸附垫、洗眼器和紧急淋浴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of absorbent pads, an eyewash station and a safety shower. No people.
shots.narration: 泄漏会处置，接触会冲洗。

shots.scene: 欣欣在关好视窗的整洁通风橱旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy fume hood with its sash closed.
shots.narration: 安全用甲醛，健康每一天，下次见！
